sources.author: faviann
sources.title: Deduplicate the managed harness list in update-agent-tools
sources.body:
## Problem

`dot_local/bin/executable_update-agent-tools` names the managed npm harnesses in three independent places, with nothing asserting they agree:

1. `MANAGED_NPM_ENGINE_COMPONENTS` — the `"Component Name|package"` array used by the engine-floor guard.
2. The `install_npm_component "Component Name" "package@latest"` call sequence in the install phase.
3. `check_toolchain`'s per-package `npm view <package>@latest version` calls and their matching `check_component` / `require_stable_version` lines.

Adding, removing, or renaming a harness is a three-site edit. Dropping an entry from site 1 is invisible to the test suite: only the engine-floor cases touch that array, and they exercise just two of the eight packages.

Sites 2 and 3 predate the Bun work; site 1 was added by the branch that moved the Bun runtime onto the updater's track (#TBD — see the Bun ownership PR).

## Also worth folding in

`check_runtime_engines` issues a second registry round trip per package:

```bash
npm view "$package@latest" engines --json
```

for the same eight packages `check_toolchain` already queries with `npm view <package>@latest version`. A single `npm view <package>@latest version engines --json` per package would halve the daily freshness check's network work.

Note this changes the command shape that a number of existing assertions in `tests/update-agent-tools-check.bash` match on (for example `^npm view @openai/codex@latest version$`), and the `wc -l query-log` counts throughout that suite. Expect real test churn — that is why it was not folded into the Bun branch.

## Suggested shape

Make the component/package array the single source and iterate it at the other two sites. A test asserting that every entry in the array is installed and version-checked would close the gap that lets site 1 drift silently.

## Constraints

- `nix flake check` is the sole closeout command (`AGENTS.md`).
- New or renamed cases must be registered both in the suite's `test_cases` array and in `tests/contracts/suite-dispatch.bash`.
